liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): Opening number features a nice punch [20]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Solo played twice the normal length [9]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Transition to The Other One is a heavy trip through the jungle [15]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Jam out of this song is very heavy [9]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Drums and Space lead into a very slow Black Peter [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-12-05.mtx.seamons.112235.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 199 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1979-12-05.aud-sbd.long.19418-and-31959.34874.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 181 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd79-12-05.aud.warner.19418.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 175 min; rated 4.26/5 by 19 [4]. Said about its sound: Direct audience sound; Garcia in excellent form, Brent's keyboards stand out [12]
- **gd79-12-05.sbd.pset2.ladner.9359.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 102 min; rated 4/5 by 9 [7]. Said about its sound: Clean soundboard recording with great balance and correct mix of each band member [10]
- **gd1979-12-05.set2-sbd.miller.31959.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 112 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [8]

## Around the show

- Second encore, Don't Ease Me In, is missing from this recording [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-12-05.mtx.seamons.112235.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: flac16: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/couple areas of EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT) [1]
- **gd1979-12-05.aud-sbd.long.19418-and-31959.34874.sbeok.flac16**: Set one is a MAC to cassette to 20-bit conversion lineage; Set two is SBD to cassette master to DAT to FLAC lineage [3]
- **gd79-12-05.aud.warner.19418.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording [4]. Also: Reviewer possesses a soundboard recording from a Dead Hour tape of sets one and two [16]
- **gd79-12-05.sbd.pset2.ladner.9359.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd1979-12-05.set2-sbd.miller.31959.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (44.1k) [8]. Also: Patches from audience cassette used for Shakedown, Other One, Bertha, and Ship Of Fools [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1979-12-05 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1979-12-05-backstage-pass/) [22]
